description: Na₂CdH₄(SeO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.75 Å. Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form CdO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra. There are four shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) H-O bond length. Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CdO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-55°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.69 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Cd, and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Cd, and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂CdSe tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one H, and one Se atom.
